title: Indexer
description: Indexer - volunteer this device to answer 'where can I find npub X'. It hands out addresses, never other people's posts.
summary: An indexer is a phone book, not a library: it remembers WHERE things are and stores no one else's content, so an indexer that vanishes costs the network a directory rather than an archive. Volunteer the device (off / when plugged in / always), see exactly what it is doing for the network — pointers held, authors it is a home for, indexers it syncs with, dead pointers pruned — and revoke it as easily as you granted it.
